question: Why land, air and bombing battles drifted from the running game hour by hour: the tactic pick, a broken support brigade, and the province fire at sea.

addresses.name: CCombat::PickTactics
addresses.comment: Land battles only, and only where both sides have a country. Each side's highest ranked leader gives a skill; **one local aggressiveness serves the pick**: the attacker's leader's unit's (CUnit::GetAggressiveness, 0x1D3F10, with the leader in ESI), **overwritten by the defender's leader's unit's** where the defender has one. The side with the lower skill picks first (CCombatant::PickTactic) favouring nothing; the other then picks **favouring the tactic that counters the first's** - the first's +0x78 - with the difference in skill. Equal skill: the attacker first, the defender second, favouring nothing. **Every branch passes the local to the attacker's pick and nought to the defender's** (the `mov [eax],0` before each defender call, 0x56EA7E, 0x56EAC1, 0x56EAE1), so the attacker picks with the defender's commander's aggressiveness where there is one and the defender never with its own. Then CCombat::SumTacticEffects. Four draws of the game's generator in all. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-combatview.md, section 11, and reversing/findings/FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 28.
addresses.evidence: Listing of 0x56E9B0..0x56EAFD read on the running game 2026-11-10: the local at [ebp-8] written from each side's leader in turn, and the three defender calls each given a zeroed first argument. Twelve picks logged with their arguments agree.

addresses.name: StaticAntiAirTerm
addresses.comment: **The province's own anti-aircraft fire, in all three bombings.** Nothing where the side has no wing to fire at. n = the province's modifier 75 x (1000 + the controller's `provincial_aa_efficiency`, CTechnologyStatus +0xA0) / 1000 x STATIC_AA_SCALE / 1000, **plus one and a half times the `air_attack` of every unit standing in the province whose owner is a friend of the controller** (CCountry::IsFriend with military access), and of every such fleet in its port (CUnitList_SumFriendlyAirAttack; the 1500 is the compiled-in static at 0x1A88154). **In a province nobody holds - a sea zone, controller the null tag - every unit of a country with no overlord counts**, the bombers and their own side's ships among them: IsFriend's overlord test compares ids and both are 0. Read live 2026-11-10 in sea zone 11448, n = 81.75 = 1.5 x every unit's air attack there, British and Italian. A carrier's air group is on the province's list with its carrier. **A fleet in a port is on both lists** - CMapProvince::AddUnit puts it on the province's units and on its CPort - **so its air attack is counted twice**; that is two readings put together and not one instruction, `inferred`. Shots = n / 1000 and a chance at one more; each at a wing drawn at random, an unused draw, the avoid roll, an organisation die of 3 to 10 and a strength die of 1 to 2, a 10% chance of five times the strength. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-bombing.md, section 7, and reversing/findings/FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 30.
addresses.evidence: A breakpoint just after n is made (0x56248D) logged n, its parts and the province list for 21 bombings over 60 hours of a series on 2026-11-10; in sea zone 11448 every unit, either side, made up n.

addresses.name: CUnitList_SumFriendlyAirAttack
addresses.no_signature: The list arrives in EAX; the out pointer and a country tag on the stack.
addresses.comment: The sum of `air_attack` out of the unit's own definition (CUnit +0xC8) over the units of a list whose owner (CUnit +0x124/+0x128) is a friend of a country: CCountry::IsFriend(owner, tag, 1), **military access counted** (the `push 1` at rva 0x1D6204). Given the null tag - a sea zone's controller - it holds for every country with no overlord. StaticAntiAirTerm asks it of the province's units and of the fleets in its port. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-bombing.md, section 7, and reversing/findings/FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 30.
addresses.evidence: Listing of 0x5D61C0..0x5D622D read 2026-11-10: push 1 then call CCountry::IsFriend; CCountry::IsFriend's listing, 0x4EF7C0.., compares the asker's overlord id (+0xF3C) with the tag's id.

notes: Section 29 (a broken support brigade leaving its unit's adjusters) was seen live and agrees with FINDINGS-unitdef.md; nothing to revise.
